guideline: The questionnaire includes questions such as C0 (visual change), C1 (semantic equivalence), C2 (spatial layout), C3 (cultural relevance), C4 (naturalness), C5 (offensiveness), E/S1 (education task or story-text match), and E/S2 (cultural relevance for application).

Evaluators answer a questionnaire of six Likert-scale questions (C0–C5) for each pipeline output, plus application‑specific questions (E1, S1, E/S2) to assess visual change, semantic equivalence, spatial layout, cultural relevance, naturalness, offensiveness, and task suitability.

You will be asked whether you agree with six questions or statements about each of the images, from 5 (strongly agree) to 1 (strongly disagree): C0) There are visual changes... C1) The image contains similar content... C2) The image maintains the spatial layout... C3) The image seems like it came from your country... C4) The image reflects naturally occurring scenes/objects... C5) This image is offensive to you...
